draft_en.subject: STH-8C24DX-HSI / STH-2C24XE-HSI — July RFQ
draft_en.body:
Hi,

In July we quoted STH-8C24DX-HSI (24x25G + 8x100G) at $2,200 USD and STH-2C24XE-HSI (24x10GBASE-T + 2x100G) at $1,700 USD (availability as quoted then; lead time to be confirmed at order). We then sent you general PoE mail, which was not what you asked for; apologies.

Both prices are re-confirmed for 15 days from this mail, MA license pre-installed, hot-swap PSU.

One question: did the July RFQ (2 + 2 units) close with another vendor, or is it still open? If closed, which price did it close at — that helps us set the OEM/ODM list you asked for in December.

Thank you.
Alan
